label: early original-phase input of l/n/r/i/x/g/s
explanation: Fires mostly (92% of mass) during the original-input phase at positions 1-4, mainly when the input token is in the set l, n, r, i, x, g, s. l is strongest (31% rate). The top activations are l/n/i/g at t=2-3 after early tokens like k, u, p, q, a. Rarely fires at t=0, after t=5, or in the delimiter and copy phases (about 8% of mass, weak scattered firing, e.g. on the first copy outputs). Other letters, and digits other than 0, almost never trigger it. Precision is limited: the same tokens at early positions are often inactive, and the context that decides this (which earlier tokens appeared) was not captured by any simple seen/first-token rule I tried.
